sloka: प्रिय कानन संचारा वन उन्मत्ता च मैथिली ।सा वनम् वा प्रविष्टा स्यात् नलिनीम् वा सुपुष्पिताम् ॥३-६१-१५॥
transliteration: priya kānana saṁcārā vana unmattā ca maithilī ।sā vanam vā praviṣṭā syāt nalinīm vā supuṣpitām ॥3-61-15॥

translations.english: Sita is madly in love with the forest. She might have entered deep into the jungle or into a fully blossomed lotuspond.
